authorization.name: food_is_platform_admin
authorization.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.food_is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'aal', '') = 'aal2' and exists (
    select 1 from public.food_platform_admins a
    where a.user_id = auth.uid() and a.active
  );
$function$

authorization.name: food_is_store_admin
authorization.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.food_is_store_admin(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.food_is_platform_admin() or exists(
    select 1
    from public.food_store_users su
    join public.food_stores s on s.id=su.store_id
    where su.store_id=p_store_id
      and su.user_id=auth.uid()
      and su.active
      and su.role in ('owner','admin','manager')
      and s.active
      and s.archived_at is null
      and s.approval_status in ('pending','approved')
  );
$function$
